reviewer_model: opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash (owner substituted; Terra/gpt-5.6-terra unavailable in this environment)
slice_scope: FIRST slice only: the class-declared ReplayRun consumer identity seam and the two-descriptor tape_manifest/tape_data grammar/binding, sufficient to enforce the pair at parse/plan time before planning or root creation. The verified captured-tape producer/capture hierarchy (ReplayTapeDataCapture/ReplayTapeManifestProducer/ReplayTapeManifestCapture, composed tape capability) and resolution to verified PUBLISHED/CAPTURED identities are the explicitly-recorded FOLLOW-ON slice, not this slice.
non_goals: composed tape capability / runtime ReplayTape construction (follow-on)
a second planner, ledger, or tape engine
imposing the tape pair on every P4 replay admission
a uses-string heuristic for ReplayRun identity

actors_and_authority.document: untrusted user-authored JSON; parsed via PipelineDocument.from_obj / NodeSpec.from_obj
actors_and_authority.resolved_node_class: trusted code (registered node kind or class ref) resolved by _resolve_uses_ordinary
actors_and_authority.planner: trusted; dskit.pipeline.planner.plan (exported dskit.pipeline.plan) attaches role rules
actors_and_authority.broker: trusted; trust.py capture/admission route (unchanged in this slice)
actors_and_authority.production_ReplayRun: dskit.production.replay.ReplayRun runnable (R1, OUT OF SCOPE this slice)
actors_and_authority.no_external_authority: this slice is parse/plan-time grammar; no broker, filesystem, or capture authority is invoked

identity_seam.mechanism: class-declared identity, never a uses-string or import-path text match. A new pipeline-owned ReplayRun consumer node class declares its identity; the planner recognizes it by resolved class (issubclass of the pipeline-owned marker/base), never by string comparison.
identity_seam.placement: dskit/pipeline/trust.py (the existing F4/F5a capture module) or a new dskit/pipeline/replay.py; frozen in Phase 0. Purity-safe: pipeline defines it, production may subclass/reference via the production->pipeline import seam (allowed).
identity_seam.role: a new ROLES member (e.g. "replay") declared by the class, consistent with 'roles are declared by the class, never config'; document NodeSpec.role is cross-checked redundancy only.
identity_seam.node_spec_contract: the ReplayRun consumer declares exactly two required top-level inputs named tape_manifest and tape_data, each the complete legal $captured_artifact descriptor (P5 shape). No third descriptor, alias key, duplicate, nested, list/map, or missing member is legal on that node.

positive_grammar.pair: a node whose resolved class is the ReplayRun consumer declares inputs equal to exactly {tape_manifest: {$captured_artifact: D1}, tape_data: {$captured_artifact: D2}}; D1 and D2 are each the exact P5 six-field descriptor.
positive_grammar.distinct_descriptors: D1 and D2 are two independently complete descriptors (normally distinct node/output); their exact equality relationship is a verification concern (follow-on), not a grammar concern in this slice.

cases: neither descriptor on a ReplayRun consumer node
a third captured descriptor beside the pair
an extra non-descriptor input wire beside the pair
same descriptor spelled twice (strict JSON loader refuses duplicate JSON keys; the design must also refuse a repeated identical descriptor value under distinct aliases)
a renamed port (e.g. manifest/data) carrying the same descriptor
a third key naming one of the two roots under another input name
a descriptor inside a list/map input value on the ReplayRun consumer
a $captured_artifact nested under a non-top-level input position
manifest and data roots/descriptors swapped between the two ports
tape_manifest bound to a data-shaped descriptor and vice versa (verification-level in follow-on; grammar-level: the two port NAMES must be exactly tape_manifest and tape_data)
two equal ConsumerCapturedPorts with different captures (follow-on verification; grammar-level: the pair names are distinct and exact)
a node whose uses STRING merely resembles 'replay' or 'ReplayRun' is not identified
a non-ReplayRun node declaring the two tape ports is NOT swept into the pair rule (compatibility)
an import-path class ref spelling 'ReplayRun' textually is not identified by string

compatibility.p4_replay: the tape pair is imposed ONLY on nodes whose resolved class is the pipeline ReplayRun consumer; accepted P4 final-replay fixtures with generic bundle/second inputs of cardinality one or two remain green.
compatibility.p5_p6: per-descriptor shape grammar (P5) and generic descriptor/receipt/port equality (P6) are unchanged; the pair rule is additive and keyed on the resolved identity.
compatibility.ordinary_docs: non-execution documents and non-ReplayRun execution documents are byte/hash-identical.
compatibility.purity: pipeline never imports production; no new module-level non-stdlib import.

forbidden_effects: planning or stage compilation completes before grammar refusal
identifying ReplayRun by a uses-string heuristic
entry_points: dskit.pipeline.planner.plan (pair rule keyed on resolved class)
dskit.pipeline.__main__ cmd_plan / cmd_run / cmd_validate / cmd_staged / cmd_walkforward

tests.new: tests/pipeline/test_replay_tape_descriptors.py: positive pair + every negative family (missing/extra/duplicate/aliased/nested/swapped/equal-port), identity-refusal (uses-string heuristic), and compatibility (P4 generic cardinality, ordinary docs).
